criteria.name: Idempotency Key Verification and Response Caching
criteria.description: Every POST that creates a charge or order requires an Idempotency-Key header. Duplicate requests return cached responses; in-flight requests return 409 Conflict.

scale.3: Strict Idempotency-Key header requirement enforced at boundary with atomic storage and cached response playback.
scale.2: Idempotency header parsed, but replay concurrency lock missing.
scale.1: Optional idempotency key or missing table index.
scale.0: No idempotency key handling present on financial POST endpoints.

criteria.name: Zero Raw Card Data (PCI DSS Compliance)
criteria.description: Zero raw 16-digit credit card PAN numbers or CVV/CVC security codes stored in tables, models, or logged. Only gateway tokens, brand, and last 4 digits stored.

scale.3: Strict tokenization only: tables store gateway token, brand, and last4. Zero raw PAN or CVV in code, schema, or logs.
scale.2: Tokenization used, but temporary in-memory variable names resemble raw card numbers.
scale.1: CVV or PAN fields present in schema or unmasked in debug logging.
scale.0: Raw credit card numbers or CVVs stored in database or printed in logs.

criteria.name: Cryptographic Webhook Signature and Replay Safety
criteria.description: Webhook endpoint cryptographically verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature using raw request bytes and webhook secret, and enforces ≤ 300s timestamp drift replay window.

scale.3: HMAC-SHA256 calculated over raw payload bytes, compared with constant-time equality, and checked against ≤ 300s timestamp drift.
scale.2: HMAC verified, but timestamp replay protection window missing.
scale.1: Signature checked against parsed JSON object or without secret.
scale.0: Webhook endpoint accepts raw unverified payloads without signature verification.

criteria.name: Failure State Preservation (Handbook AC-012)
criteria.description: Payment decline preserves unpaid order status, prevents fulfillment, and returns standard customer message 'Payment failed, you were not charged'.

scale.3: Full AC-012 compliance: gateway decline preserves unpaid status, rolls back transaction, and returns RFC 9457 Problem Details error.
scale.2: Decline handled, but error message wording imprecise.
scale.0: Failed payment silently swallows error or leaves record in paid state.
